summary: Scope membership frontiers to the serving store lifetime as well as projection generation

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild is required.

schema.detail: The local State and canonical graph schema are unchanged. The store-open nonce is nonpersistent API identity.

compatibility.detail: Pages and opted stream snapshot/changes frames encode the same opaque epoch from the opened store nonce and transactional projection generation. Epochs are equality-only; generation and index alone are not cross-lifetime frontiers.

manual.detail: No manual action is required. Daemon restart, store reopen/replacement and restore make old cursors incomparable even at equal host, index and persisted generation.

recovery.detail: The exact membership-frontier-reset 409 code maps to the typed client reset/restart path and discards all staged pages. Same-process reopen/restore tests compare page and stream metadata and use changed restored rows at equal index. No capability is advertised here.
